about: Step 6, temp book staging/sprites.js (Mid's 18-figures and 19-building-art): every piece. in v100: already home (v100 took preview 49's figures and building art, Nov 4). bring: Mid has it, v100 does not; it comes as Sprites book entries with its feature (most are the skins held in preview 49). cut: v100 does it another way, or Albert cut it (then also in misfits). LOOKS, ART and WONDERART carry a line per row.
